question: Are AI systems integrators a high-growth high-profit bottleneck?
conclusion: Deployment, data quality, integration and workflow redesign are verified demand bottlenecks; services sector-wide premium margins and rapid earnings growth are not established.

evidence.finding: 22% of organizations scaled AI across multiple business units
2026 consulting tech sector bifurcation: faster AI-forward subset and broader cohort 0-8% revenue growth
Genpact ATS revenue +24.1% but total +7.1% and company net margin 10.8%
CTSH Q3 revenue +4.6% and adjusted operating margin 16.3%

ranking_by_potential: embedded vertical platforms with recurring managed agents
repeatable integration accelerators and ongoing managed service
risks: agentic coding automates provider's own billable hours
implementation costs and liability erode margins
validation_metrics: operating margin and free cash flow
customer realized labor saving net of agent cost
status: research thesis, not validated investment return forecast
